title: Read and set an element's parameters by name or BuiltInParameter, and delete an element
task: Read an element parameter with Element.LookupParameter (display name) or Element.get_Parameter(BuiltInParameter), check StorageType and IsReadOnly before Parameter.Set, convert a length with UnitUtils.ConvertToInternalUnits, then delete an element with Document.Delete and confirm GetElement returns null.

pitfalls.symptom: Parameter.Set throws InvalidOperationException and the whole block rolls back.
pitfalls.cause: The parameter is read-only (a computed value such as Length or Area), or the Set overload does not match its StorageType.
pitfalls.fix: Check IsReadOnly and StorageType first and pick the matching Set overload.

pitfalls.symptom: A length set to 3000 becomes 3000 feet (914 m).
pitfalls.cause: Double parameters are in Revit's internal units (decimal feet), not the project's display units.
pitfalls.fix: Convert with UnitUtils.ConvertToInternalUnits(value, UnitTypeId.Millimeters) before Set, and ConvertFromInternalUnits after AsDouble.

pitfalls.symptom: LookupParameter returns null or the wrong parameter.
pitfalls.cause: Display names are localized and can be shared by a type and an instance parameter.
pitfalls.fix: Use get_Parameter(BuiltInParameter.X) for built-ins; keep LookupParameter for project and shared parameters.
